g.text: A JFET transfer law describes saturation current while the output family shows the region boundary

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: n-channel JFET, reverse-biased gate, V_P≤V_GS≤0. Transfer law applies in saturation at V_DS≥V_GS−V_P; cutoff at V_GS≤V_P. Output triode curves use a compatible
square-law model with no channel-length modulation. Gold boundary locus connects V_DS=V_GS−V_P and corresponding I_D, not a load line. Pinch-off saturation is not
